start.title: Tears at Dawn
start.text:
The tomb is open. He is gone.
Your tears fall on the cold stone.

choices.feedback: Stay. Hope is closer than you know.

choices.text: Stay and weep at the door
choices.feedback: John 20:11 — Mary Magdalene stood outside the tomb weeping.
Anger blinds the eyes to wonder.

run_consequence.title: Do Not Flee
run_consequence.text:
Love does not run from an empty grave.
Linger. Something holy waits here.

choices.text: Stay and weep at the door

curse_consequence.title: Not Anger
curse_consequence.text:
No hand stole Him. Be still.
Let your tears speak instead.

choices.text: Stay and weep at the door

angels_ask.title: Two in White
angels_ask.text:
Two shining figures ask gently,
"Woman, why are you weeping?"

choices.feedback: John 20:13 — Mary Magdalene answered the angels, "They have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."

boast_consequence.title: Not Pride
boast_consequence.text:
This sorrow is not yours alone.
Speak simply. Tell them your grief.

demand_consequence.title: Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
Heaven does not answer demands.
Speak softly. Let love show.

stranger.title: Someone Behind You
stranger.text:
You turn. A figure stands in soft light.
You think He is the gardener.

choices.feedback: Listen. He is about to speak.

choices.text: Speak to Him in plain hope
choices.feedback: John 20:15 — Mary Magdalene, supposing Him to be the gardener, asked Him where He had laid Jesus.

choices.text: Accuse Him of moving the body

ignore_consequence.title: Do Not Turn Away
ignore_consequence.text:
He waits with patience for you.
Lift your eyes and speak.

choices.text: Speak to Him in plain hope

accuse_consequence.title: Not Accusation
accuse_consequence.text:
Do not wound the stranger.
Ask simply, and you will be heard.

choices.text: Speak to Him in plain hope
choices.feedback: Your words soften to a plea.

gardener_dialog.title: Tell Me Where
gardener_dialog.text:
"Sir, if you took Him, tell me where,
and I will carry Him away."

choices.feedback: John 20:15 — Mary Magdalene asked the man she thought was the gardener to tell her where he had laid Jesus so she could take Him away.

beg_consequence.title: Be Still
beg_consequence.text:
Anger drowns the voice you long for.
Quiet your heart and listen.

walk_consequence.title: Do Not Leave
walk_consequence.text:
What you seek stands beside you.
Turn back. Be present.

name_called.title: He Speaks Your Name
name_called.text:
One word. Soft. Familiar.
"Mary." The world stops.

choices.text: Reason it must be someone else

choices.feedback: John 20:16 — When Jesus called her name, Mary Magdalene turned and recognized Him.

doubt_consequence.title: Trust the Voice
doubt_consequence.text:
No other voice has called you home.
Let your name reach your heart.

reason_consequence.title: Beyond Reason
reason_consequence.text:
Some moments do not bend to logic.
Turn. See with your own eyes.

recognition.title: Rabboni
recognition.text:
It is Him. Alive. Radiant.
"Rabboni!" bursts from your lips.

choices.text: Cling to Him with all your strength
choices.feedback: Joy does not need to grasp.
John 20:16 — Mary Magdalene turned and said to Him, "Rabboni!" (which means Teacher).

choices.text: Faint and look away in fear
choices.feedback: Lift your eyes. He is here.

cling_consequence.title: Do Not Hold On
cling_consequence.text:
He says, "Do not cling to me.
I have not yet ascended."

faint_consequence.title: Rise and See
faint_consequence.text:
He is not a ghost. He is risen.
Lift your eyes and meet Him.

do_not_cling.title: Go to My Brothers
do_not_cling.text:
"Go tell my brothers," He says.
"I ascend to my Father and yours."

choices.text: Go at once with His message
choices.feedback: John 20:17 — Jesus told Mary Magdalene not to cling to Him, but to go to His brothers and tell them He was ascending to His Father and their Father, to His God and their God.

choices.text: Argue they will not believe you

refuse_consequence.title: He Sends You
refuse_consequence.text:
This joy is meant to be carried.
Go. The others wait in darkness.

choices.text: Go at once with His message

argue_consequence.title: Tell Them Anyway
argue_consequence.text:
Belief is not yours to give.
Your task is only to tell.

choices.text: Go at once with His message

tell_disciples.title: I Have Seen the Lord
tell_disciples.text:
Hands trembling, you knock and speak:
"I have seen the Lord!"

choices.feedback: John 20:18 — Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, "I have seen the Lord," and told them what He had said to her.

pride_end_consequence.title: Joy for All
pride_end_consequence.text:
This morning belongs to everyone.
Give the news, not yourself.

choices.feedback: You lower your voice in awe.

whisper_consequence.title: Speak Clearly
whisper_consequence.text:
Hope must be heard to be carried.
Lift your voice. Tell them all.

ending.title: He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
He called your name. You are changed.
The morning belongs to hope.
